My appointment was scheduled for 11:00 AM, and I reached half an hour early, but even at 11, the previous appointments were still pending. The process is painfully slow and poorly managed, with only two counters operating. The staff is rude, unhelpful, and completely unprofessional. When asked for basic information, they simply say, “Inquire online, we’re not here to help.”

After waiting for over 3 hours, my application was rejected without proper guidance. I immediately rescheduled my appointment at Malad, where the experience was completely different and much better.

I do not recommend the Vasai East Passport Seva Kendra to anyone. If possible, go to Thane or Malad centers instead — they are far more organized and professional.
